subject.title: fix(cron): suppress control diagnostics in delivery

question: Should NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED be treated as a shared outbound control reply across channels, or only suppressed for Matrix cron delivery?
rationale: The PR deliberately preserves non-Matrix delivery, but current main now centralizes cron control-token suppression through a shared outbound classifier, so merge would otherwise create competing policy sources.

options.title: Use Shared Control Replies
options.body: Rebase and add NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED to src/gateway/control-reply-text.ts with cron/gateway coverage so the token is suppressed consistently.

options.title: Approve Matrix-Only Exception
options.body: Keep the suppression Matrix-specific, but make the exception explicit in cron delivery with tests proving non-Matrix delivery remains intentional.

options.title: Pause Diagnostic Scope
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether this diagnostic is an internal control token or a channel-specific Matrix workaround.

recommendation.title: Use Shared Control Replies
recommendation.body: Rebase and add NO_SUBPROCESS_STARTED to src/gateway/control-reply-text.ts with cron/gateway coverage so the token is suppressed consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main cron delivery change that established the shared control-reply path in this runtime area.
